notes: DDR5 characterization centers on the DQ eye with DFE, internal VrefDQ/VrefCA centering, the Duty-Cycle Adjuster, ZQ calibration, the core timing parameters, refresh retention, and the on-module PMIC rails. Training (CA / read / write, DFE tap, Vref) is performed at bring-up; conformance is established by JEDEC DDR5 compliance testing.
calibration_summary: HBM3 at up to 6.4 Gb/s/pin over short interposer links requires per-channel PHY training: write/read leveling, DQ-to-strobe centering, drive-strength/termination tuning. Refresh is calibrated to temperature via TEMP, and RAS soft-repair is exercised during screening. Calibration is per-channel because the 16 channels are independent.

wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.purpose: Phase-lock the DRAM's internal WCK to CK for deterministic high-speed data timing.
wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.trigger: At init, before high-speed transfers, after DVFS change, after deep-sleep exit.
wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.carried_by: CAS command on the CA bus.
wck2ck_synchronization_procedure.error_recovery: If the WCK eye is not centered, adjust WCK phase / leveling and re-issue the synchronization.

read_training_procedure.purpose: Find the optimal DQ sampling phase relative to the DRAM-driven RDQS.
read_training_procedure.prerequisites: WCK locked to CK; DFE / equalization configured for the frequency set point.
procedure: 1. Issue RDCAL / read the internal FIFO for a deterministic pattern.
2. Sweep the DQ sampling phase with configured DFE taps.
3. Compare per-phase; record the pass window; pick the center.
read_training_procedure.error_recovery: If no pass window is found, re-run ZQ calibration / WCK2CK sync, adjust DFE taps and Vref(dq), or reduce the frequency set point.

write_training_procedure.purpose: Center the controller-driven WCK / DQ write eye at the DRAM sampling point.
procedure: 1. Use the Write FIFO to load a known pattern.
2. Sweep WCK-to-DQ phase and Vref(dq); read back; pick the best.
write_training_procedure.error_recovery: Adjust WCK leveling, output-driver impedance, and Vref(dq); retrain.

dvfs_retraining: After a frequency-set-point change (DVFS / DVFSC), re-run ZQ calibration, WCK2CK sync, read training, and write training with the FSP-specific RL/WL/ODT/Vref/DFE values.
link_training_procedure: 1. Coarse/fine write leveling to align WDQS per channel.
2. Read leveling / DQ-RDQS centering with known patterns.
3. Drive-strength / termination tuning for 6.4 Gb/s/pin via mode registers.
4. Per-pseudo-channel verification of independent column streams.
refresh_temperature_calibration: 2. Select refresh interval / RFM thresholds appropriate to temperature.
3. Re-evaluate periodically; increase refresh rate when hot.
repair_and_screening: 1. Apply factory hard-repair fuse maps during screening.
2. Run KGSD screening through the base-die test ports.
3. Exercise runtime soft-repair for in-field RAS.
no_analog_trim_at_protocol_interface: HBM3 is a digital memory interface; calibration is link/PHY training, refresh-temperature adaptation, and repair rather than analog converter trim.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: DQ eye / DFE
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the DQ data eye with Decision Feedback Equalization across the speed bins (DDR5-3200 .. DDR5-8400).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: VrefDQ / VrefCA centering
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the internal reference voltages center the sampling point during training.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure DQ/DQS duty cycle after DCA correction.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: ZQ calibration
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify output-driver / ODT impedance against the ZQ reference resistor.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Timing parameters
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate tRCD / tRP / tRAS / tRFC / tCCD / tWR / CL at the target speed bin.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm REFab / REFsb and tREFI retention.
